newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: High seller prices keep European feeds subdued.
newsitem.headline: High seller prices keep European feeds subdued.

text.p: Higher seller prices for most products on yesterday's sharply higher Chicago soycomplex futures close kept a lid on activity on the European meals and feeds market ahead of the weekend, dealers said.
"The stronger seller prices and a weaker Chicago soymeal futures opening this afternoon kept most buyers sidelined today," one broker said.

Afloat Argentine sunmeal pellets traded at $142 and $136 a tonne cif Rotterdam from two vessels. March EU rapemeal changed hands at 30.75 marks per 100 kg fob lower Rhine, May 29.25 and Nov/Jan at 26.50 marks fob.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
